# .github/

GitHub infrastructure:

- **workflows/ci.yml** — CI/CD pipeline (test, lint, build, import sweep)
- **ISSUE_TEMPLATE/** — bug report and feature request templates
- **PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/** — PR checklist template

> Release workflow: not yet configured. Add `workflows/release.yml` when you start
> tagging releases (see `CHANGELOG.md`).
